title: Restricted h22 padded triple covers: conditional κ = 4.20151003347e-4
body:
**κ ≈ 4.20151003347 × 10⁻⁴.**

Restrict the immutable PR117 scalar DAG to its first 22 coordinates, regenerate its physical word, and put it in the paid sequential triple cover from #137. This improves #137 and its slack-tightened successor #138 by about **1.58%** under the same inherited multiplication interfaces. All three stages retain completed sequential dirty-transparent cores.

The restriction zeros omitted inputs, contracts unary additions and merges equal supports. The original witness remains pinned; the verifier reconstructs the derived DAG and checks every retained root support. The resulting word has 64,140 live additions, 22,977 virtual scratch roles and 21,274 physical slots after 1,703 compensated reuses. Readout coefficients use exact numerator/38 chunks. Arbitrary operation frames and source gauges are regenerated with the padded-cover objective.

| Per three-vertex cell | Complex | Retained bit |
|---|---:|---:|
| Local / ambient dimension | 22 / 66 | 23 / 69 |
| Persistent roles | 73,062 | 97,224 |
| Recursive rank | 4,817,010 | 6,702,384 |
| Deficit | 5,082 | 6,072 |
| Largest child | 60 | 66 |

All nine local words, 9,240 width-two complex data finishes and every physical auxiliary tail remain paid. Zero-rank tails retain their scalar adapter charge. The finite router and semantic budget are recomputed using the complete group order. The local scalar guard uses 22,977 virtual roles and 85,577 reserved workspace operations, above the actual 76,778. The independent literal audit counts all **7,075,117** expanded scalar operations per stage, checks exact frame incidences, arbitrary dirty cancellation and the actual reversed chronology.

The complex saving is **210252177/500000000000 = 0.000420504354**. The unchanged weighted bit supplier supports **11265104579/25000000000000 = 0.00045060418316**, including the full fallback, atom conversion and restored internal rows. Exact assembly uses β = 10⁻¹⁸, η = 10⁻¹⁵ and backoff 10⁻²⁶; the complex side binds.

**Validation at current head `2fc6cf5`:** deterministic fresh restriction/compiler/gauge/reuse regeneration and the full literal reflection audit pass. The finite geometry checks all subspaces and ordered pairs through dimension four and all 1,540 actual ports; padded geometry checks all 764 physical source-frame types. Exact assembly passes 47 strict constraints, seven positive margins and rejection of the next grid point. All **37 corruption controls pass**, including in the publication checkout. The complete frozen aggregate passes: original-witness restriction, fresh compiler and independent literal reflection, both padded ledgers, exact assembly, all 37 controls, and an unchanged source snapshot. Generated profiles and receipts reproduce byte for byte. All **45 current-head CI checks pass**, including the complete focused verifier on Python 3.11, 3.13 and 3.14.

```sh
python3 research/cover-local-reuse/verify.py
```

The aggregate reconstructs everything in a temporary copy, requires byte-identical profiles and receipts, and checks that the frozen source closure stays unchanged. The focused workflow covers Python 3.11, 3.13 and 3.14. Concise arguments are in `research/cover-local-reuse/PADDED-GEOMETRY.md` and `BIT-PADDED.md`.

This remains a conditional finite multiplication witness for `T(n) = O(n(log n)^(1−κ))`. General Clifford normal forms, common generic bases, uniform weighted local-ring compilation, restored row borrowing, analytic recovery and fixed-tape transfer remain explicit inherited contracts. The simultaneous-core execution proposed in #139 is a separate, explicitly unproved transfer hypothesis and is not used here.
